title: Design System: Dr. N.R. Acharya Memorial Hospital

display.purpose: Hero h1 only. One per page. Carries the page's headline statement.

headline.purpose: Section h2 across the site. Anchors each section block.

title.purpose: Card titles, doctor names, footer column headers.

body.purpose: All reading copy. Cap line length at 65 to 75 characters in long-form sections.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked label sitting above section h2, on buttons, and on badges. The 0.08em letter-spacing is the signature.

shadows.name: shadow-xs
shadows.purpose: Resting hairline shadow available on form inputs and outline buttons. Optional. Use only when a tonal border alone is insufficient.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Hover-lift shadow for cards and the scrolled-state navbar. The only state-driven shadow in the system.

motion.name: duration-color
motion.purpose: Color-only transitions on links and buttons.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal entrance for content blocks (opacity + translate).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions. Ease-out only. No bounce, no spring.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default brand action. Clinical Teal background, used sparingly as the one accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #14B8A6; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2DD4BF; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.5); }

components.name: Secondary Button (Navy)
components.description: Used to balance a Primary teal CTA on the same surface. Reads as institutional, calm.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #0A2540; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #081C32; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.5); }

components.name: Department Card
components.description: The canonical card pattern: leading icon container, Playfair title, muted body, inline link affordance. Flat at rest, lifts on hover.

components.css: .ds-card { display: block; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: #14B8A6; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card-row { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-icon-circle { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #E0F2F1; color: #0D9488; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-card-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #1A2332; margin: 0 0 4px 0; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-title { color: #0D9488; } .ds-card-text { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #64748B; margin: 0 0 12px 0; } .ds-card-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #0D9488; }

components.name: Filter Pills

components.css: .ds-pill-group { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-pill { background: #F8FAFB; color: #64748B; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-pill:hover { background: #E0F2F1; color: #0D9488; } .ds-pill-active { background: #14B8A6; color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #14B8A6; } .ds-pill-active:hover { background: #14B8A6; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.5); }

narrative.overview: This system is for Dr. N.R. Acharya Memorial Hospital, a 40+ year community hospital on the Karavali coast of Karnataka, founded in 1983 in memory of Dr. N. R. Acharya. It is not a corporate hospital chain. It is not a Western health startup. It is the local family doctor at scale: a real institution with a real founder, a real address, real phone numbers, and decades of unbroken service to rural patients in Koteshwara and the surrounding villages of Udupi district. The visual language is plain and professional. Warmth comes from tone and restraint, from plain language, generous spacing, real specifics, and human portraits, not from gradients, glassmorphism, animated flourish, or maximal color. The site's primary user arrives in a hurry, on a phone, on a 3G signal, with a sick relative in mind. Everything on the page must answer to that user first.
keyCharacteristics: Plain and professional palette: institutional, not decorative.
Serif display + humanist sans body: gravity in headings, clarity in reading.
Flat surfaces at rest; hover-lift only as a response to interaction.
Mobile-first geometry: large tap targets, type sized for arm-length phone reading.
Bilingual-ready (Kannada + English) as a peer experience, not a translation overlay.
Performance is a brand value: slow 3G is the design target, not an exception.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Clinical Teal is the only chromatic accent. It carries primary CTAs, eyebrow labels, section underlines, and icon glyphs. It must not be paired with another saturated accent on the same screen. The legacy --warm-gold token is forbidden in production surfaces.

rules.name: The Navy-Or-Mint Rule
rules.body: Strong sections use Hospital Navy (committed, institutional) or Surgical Mint (soft, calm). They never appear together as adjacent full-bleed sections; one must be separated from the other by a Paper White or White section.

rules.name: The Black-And-Pure-White Ban
rules.body: Pure black and a flat printer's white are not in this palette. Text uses Ink (#1A2332); surfaces use White or Paper White.

rules.name: The Playfair-For-Headings-Only Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display is reserved for h1, h2, h3, and the hospital wordmark. It must never appear on body copy, button labels, navigation links, or form fields.

rules.name: The 65ch Reading Rule
rules.body: All long-form body copy caps at 65 to 75 characters per line. Edge-to-edge prose is forbidden.

rules.name: The Single Display Per Page Rule
rules.body: Only one Display-size headline per page. Subsequent sections use Headline.

rules.name: The Bilingual Pairing Rule
rules.body: Kannada copy uses Noto Sans Kannada at the same size and weight as the Inter equivalent. The two language layers must visually weigh the same on a page.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state: hover, scroll, focus.

rules.name: The Two-Step-Shadow Ban
rules.body: No second elevation tier. Hover (shadow-lg) is the only sanctioned elevation. No Material Design shadow ladder.

dos: Do use Clinical Teal sparingly, as the one accent. Keep its surface footprint under 10% per screen.
Do lead every department, service, and value with an icon container, never a colored side stripe.
Do keep cards flat at rest. Apply shadow-lg and -translate-y-1 only on hover.
Do use Playfair Display only for h1, h2, h3, and the hospital wordmark. Body, labels, navigation, and buttons stay in Inter.
Do size body type for arm-length phone reading (16px minimum, 1.65 line-height) and treat 3G performance as a hard budget.

Do carry every anti-reference from PRODUCT.md through to implementation: corporate-hospital chain glossiness, Western telehealth-startup warmth-strip, decorative overload, identical-card grids, template-y AI feel.
Do treat Kannada as a peer language. Both versions must read naturally and both must reach the emergency phone numbers in the same number of taps.
Do earn trust with specifics: years, names, places, phone numbers, department counts. Not stock photos or superlatives.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated accent. The --warm-gold token is forbidden in production surfaces.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on any element.
Don't apply background-clip: text with a gradient on any heading. Gradient text is forbidden across the system.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. The one sanctioned use is the scrolled navbar; everywhere else it is forbidden.
Don't ship the hero-metric template (huge gradient number, label, supporting stats with chromatic accent).
Don't stack identical icon-plus-heading-plus-paragraph cards as the dominant pattern of more than two consecutive sections.
Don't nest cards. A card never contains another card.
Don't use pure #000000 or a flat printer's #FFFFFF for text. Text is Ink (#1A2332); body surfaces are Paper White or White.
Don't introduce em dashes in shipped UI copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't use bouncy, elastic, or playful easing curves. Motion is ease-out only, no spring physics.
Don't animate CSS layout properties (width, height, top, left, padding). Only opacity and transform.
Don't ship hero imagery that is stock-photo gloss or generic medical clip-art. If a real founder portrait or a real ward photo is not available, ship without imagery.
